description: Individuals not permitted to access and obtain copies of their PHI.
applicability: This signal applies to: Healthcare providers with direct patient relationships Health plans and insurers Healthcare clearinghouses Business associates handling PHI Patient-facing systems and portals Human resources and workforce management functions

metadata.detection_notes: Detect absence of access request mechanisms, denied access requests without valid grounds for denial, or systems that do not provide individuals the ability to inspect and obtain copies of their PHI in designated record sets.
